level.A1: Understands familiar everyday expressions and very simple sentences, and can say a little about themselves and their surroundings.
level.A2: Understands frequently used expressions and can hold simple, short exchanges on familiar topics.
level.B1: Follows the main point of everyday topics, copes with common situations such as travel and work, and writes short connected texts.
level.B2: Understands the main points of complex texts, talks with native speakers comfortably and naturally, and writes detailed texts.
level.C1: Understands long, demanding texts and implied meaning, expresses ideas fluently and flexibly, and produces well-organised, detailed writing.
level.C2: Understands virtually everything heard or read with ease and conveys fine shades of meaning precisely.
level.A0: Is at the very beginning of German: there is no language use yet that can be assessed at A1.

integrityFlags.headSerious: {n, plural, one {# serious flag} other {# serious flags}}
integrityFlags.headSettled: {n, plural, one {# flag} other {# flags}} settled
integrityFlags.warnings: Warnings shown to the student: up to {n}
integrityFlags.technicalHint: Connection and system records. Not a reason for suspicion on their own.
integrityFlags.badgeTitle: {n, plural, one {# serious flag} other {# serious flags}}
integrityFlags.reportNote: Flags are ordered for the teacher's review and are not a decision on their own. The decision is the integrity decision above.

resultLevel.A0Note: A0 (Pre-A1): below A1, no German that can be scored yet.
resultLevel.A0Class: A0 (Pre-A1): starts in the first course, A1.1.
resultLevel.A0Pick: A0 (Pre-A1) only when there is no German to score: a blank answer or one not in German.
resultLevel.atChance: At chance: {right} of {answered} answered A1-A2 units right, no better than guessing; so A0
resultLevel.atChanceBlank: Left blank: nothing in this section was answered; so A0
resultLevel.chanceBelowPooled: A0 comes from a section at chance, while the combined estimate is A1 or higher. A teacher decides.

courseInvite.kindINTERIMHint: At the end of the first half of a level.
courseInvite.kindFINALHint: At the end of a whole level.
courseInvite.courseHintINTERIM: A student who passes continues in the second half of the same level; one who does not repeats the first half.
courseInvite.courseHintFINAL: A student who passes starts the next level (part 1). For the others Kademe recommends which course to join.
courseInvite.formHint: Automatic: the list gets form A, B, A, B in turn, and a returning student gets the form they have not seen. Choosing A or B gives everyone that form.
